chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Amr ibn Maymun, from 'Ammar ibn Marwan, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, we recognize the man, when we see him, by the reality of faith and the reality of hypocrisy.

key_terms.الرَّجُلَ: the person or man being observed
key_terms.النِّفَاقِ: hypocrisy in its actual inner reality
key_terms.الْإِيمَانِ: faith in its genuine inner reality
key_terms.بِحَقِيقَةِ: by the true reality or essential nature
key_terms.لَنَعْرِفُ: we surely recognize; a strong affirmation of certain knowledge

ai.seo_question: How do the Imams عليهم السلام recognize whether a person has true faith or hypocrisy?
ai.summary: Abu Ja'far عليه السلام states that they discern people according to the true reality of iman and nifaq within them. The hadith points to the special divinely granted insight of the Imam عليه السلام into the inner spiritual state of persons.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Amro Bin Maymoun, from Ammar Bin Marwan, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Weasws tend to recognise the man when weasws see him by the reality of the Eman and the reality of the hypocrisy’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Sa‘id from ‘Amr ibn Maymun from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan from Jabir from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following.
“We know men when we see them through the reality of faith and the reality of hypocrisy.”
